prompt.text:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this extracted square110-degree normal perspective from the finished illustrated outdoor sphere. Same exact camera/framing/lighting and rich detailed warm storybook style. Keep outermost15percent of borders registered for blending, and reconstruct the faulty central material naturally. Return the same square ordinary perspective, not a new panorama. No text, characters, structures, new landmarks, borders or diagrams.
The camera looks STRAIGHT DOWN at natural lakeshore ground. Remove the pinched central soil/moss rosette and warped concentric mound caused by the original spherical pole. Rebuild continuous physically FLAT irregular earth/pebbles/leaves/moss with natural roots, coherent individual stones and ordinary grounded vegetation. No radial symmetry, starburst, miniatureplanet, whirlpool or new decorative medallion. Preserve shoreline water/reeds and larger rocks at the surrounding edges, preserving camera position on dry ground just beside the water; no new island, no lake in the central soil. Maintain all natural cast shadows and warm lighting. The center is plain varied soil and moss, not an object hiding the defect.

references.role: current base plus repaired rear downward view

review.result: cardinal and oblique views pass; no obvious hard seam or pole pinch; minor illustration softness remains
